reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS DATE) AS month_start, store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
FROM orders
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY month_start, store_id
ORDER BY month_start, store_id
alternatives: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS month_start, store_id, COUNT(order_id) AS n_orders FROM orders WHERE CAST(order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS month_start, store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-30 22:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:00:00' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

other_way.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS month_start, store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-30 22:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:00:00' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

solver.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) AS d
  FROM orders
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', d) AS DATE) AS month_start, store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
FROM t
WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY month_start ASC, store_id ASC
